Attalon, Inc. develops optical and laser technologies for the aerospace and defense industry. The Software Engineer, Embedded Systems will contribute to software and firmware for electronic systems supporting high-power fiber lasers and amplifiers, and provide hands-on support for deployed systems.
Aerospace
Manufacturing
Commercial
No H1B
Responsibilities
Contribute to the software and firmware development of electronic systems containing embedded microcontrollers and FPGAs
Support prototyping and bring-up of printed circuit boards, cable harnesses, and embedded hardware assemblies containing programmable devices
Participate in testing and validation of new and existing electronics and software
Create documentation including test plans/test reports, design notes, manufacturing instructions, interface control documents, and operating instructions
Collaborate cross functionally to resolve issues during development, integration, transition to manufacturing, and field operation
Infrequent travel for hands-on field support, conferences, etc
Other duties as required
